text: dsh-wsl-tray-launcher 是面向 Windows 与 WSL 桌面用户的 DSH 插件，可为运行在 WSL 中的 dsh web 安装启动器或报告现有路径。它向 DSH 注册 wsl_tray 工具，提供状态查询、PowerShell 脚本安装和 AutoHotkey 托盘安装。生成的启动脚本可启动或重启套件服务、打开带令牌的 Web 界面并运行健康检查，也可创建桌面快捷方式。适合希望从 Windows 桌面管理 WSL 内 DSH Web 的用户；需要 Windows、WSL、dsh-wsl-kit 目录，托盘模式还需要 AutoHotkey v2。

dsh-wsl-tray-launcher provides wsl_tray to manage dsh web in WSL from Windows. It reports status and installs launch, health-check, and tokenized-UI scripts, a desktop shortcut, or an AutoHotkey v2 tray menu. Requires Windows, WSL, and dsh-wsl-kit.
我想从 Windows 桌面启动在 WSL 里运行的 DSH Web。
能不能给 WSL 里的 dsh web 加一个系统托盘菜单？
希望用桌面快捷方式重启 WSL 中的 Web 服务。
我需要快速打开带访问令牌的本地 DSH 页面。
怎么在 Windows 上检查 WSL 里的 DSH Web 是否健康？
让 DSH Web 的启动和健康检查可以从托盘菜单操作。
I want a Windows tray menu to manage my DSH web app running in WSL.
How can I open the tokenized local DSH page from a desktop shortcut?
功能「状态查询」：检查 dsh-wsl-kit 路径并报告脚本、托盘文件和建议。调用 wsl_tray 时使用 status 动作（默认动作），结果包含检测到的路径和状态。
功能「启动脚本安装」：生成 PowerShell 启动、打开界面和健康检查脚本，并尝试创建 Windows 桌面快捷方式。通过 wsl_tray 的 install_scripts 动作触发。
功能「托盘菜单安装」：生成 AutoHotkey v2 托盘脚本，提供打开令牌页面、启动或重启 WSL 服务及健康检查菜单。通过 install_tray 动作触发。
功能「令牌页面打开」：启动脚本读取 WSL 的 /tmp/dsh-ui-url，并打开当前带 token 的 URL；没有令牌时提示先启动服务。
dsh-wsl-kit 必须能通过 kitPath 参数、DSH_WSL_KIT 环境变量或候选目录找到；否则安装动作返回 kit_path_missing。
安装托盘菜单需要 Windows 上可检测到的 AutoHotkey v2；脚本文件写入 WSL 用户目录 ~/.dsh/tray。

DeepSeek Harness plugin: install or report a **Windows tray / shortcut** launcher for `dsh web` running in WSL (start, restart, health).

Part of **[dsh-wsl-kit](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-kit)**.

dsh-wsl-tray-launcher README · Where it sits：Installs or reports a Windows tray shortcut that opens the dsh web UI.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  tray["Windows tray shortcut"] --> relay[":3081/?token="] --> dsh["dsh web in WSL"]
```

Suite diagram and version snapshot: [dsh-wsl-kit](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-kit#how-the-pieces-fit). This plugin is **0.2.4** (full; also in llm). Do not copy that matrix into this README.

dsh-wsl-tray-launcher README · Compatibility：Suite floor versions: kit [`check-plugin-versions.sh`](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-kit/blob/master/scripts/check-plugin-versions.sh). Fault tree: [TROUBLESHOOTING.md](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-kit/blob/master/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md).

**Scope:** Windows tray/shortcut around kit start/restart/health. Open the URL with `?token=` from restart output or `/tmp/dsh-ui-url` (dsh ≥0.1.2).

dsh-wsl-tray-launcher README · Why：Clicking a tray icon is easier than remembering WSL + `restart-dsh-web.sh`. The hard part after dsh **0.1.2** is the **one-shot launch token**: bare `http://127.0.0.1:3081/` returns **401**. Tray actions should open the token URL (or re-run restart so a fresh token is printed).

dsh-wsl-tray-launcher README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:173787247/dsh-wsl-tray

dsh-wsl-tray-launcher README · or local:：dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-wsl-tray
```

Restart `dsh web` and open a **new** session. Tool: `wsl_tray`.

Set `DSH_WSL_KIT` to your kit checkout (or pass `kitPath`). Tray menu includes **Start / Restart** and **Health check** ([`scripts/check-dsh-health.sh`](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-kit/blob/master/scripts/check-dsh-health.sh)).

dsh-wsl-tray-launcher README · Usage notes：- Prefer kit [`restart-dsh-web.sh`](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-kit/blob/master/scripts/restart-dsh-web.sh) so proxy env + relay stay correct.
- After restart, open the printed `ui=` URL (also in WSL `/tmp/dsh-ui-url`). Do not bookmark bare `:3081`.
- Token is **one-shot per process** — restarting dsh invalidates the previous token.
